name: Commander Zog
description: a small round Pixar-style 3D alien commander, smooth lavender-purple skin with a soft highlight, a big pear-shaped head, two large glossy yellow eyes with thick dark angry eyebrows, two bendy antennae with glowing orange tips, a silver chest plate with a small glowing round translator badge, short stubby arms and legs
voice: deep booming villain voice, Hindi, that cracks into a flustered squeak when he is confused
signature: taps and shakes the glowing translator badge on his chest
props: a chunky silver ray gun (per shot, not part of the frozen description)
doNot: no clothes beyond the silver chest plate

images.anchor: see prompts.md — generated in Google Vids (Nano Banana), lives in the Vids project; no download offered by Vids

notes: Allied cast member of the Aliens vs Humans series. Translator gag: his menacing intent is delivered through a broken translator, so the Hindi words that come out are always politer than he means. Anchor accepted first try on 2026-11-05.
